key_insight: Q-PhotoMarket shows that photonic hybrid quantum neural network performance in financial prediction depends strongly on circuit design choices, and that systematic exploration can uncover robust high-performing configurations across markets.
engineering_relevance: The framework provides a practical design-space exploration workflow for selecting photonic HQNN architectures that are competitive with classical baselines and suitable for finance-oriented quantum ML development.
method: Covered input photon states, circuit architectures, entangling models, and measurement strategies
Used Bayesian optimization plus threshold calibration and prediction-collapse diagnostics
evidence_signal: The study evaluates configurations across U.S., Indian, and cryptocurrency markets and reports competitive performance versus classical machine learning baselines.
watch_item: Results may depend on threshold choices and class imbalance, so prediction-collapse diagnostics and calibration are important to avoid overstating performance.
paper_title: Q-PhotoMarket: A Design Space Exploration Framework for Photonic Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks in Financial Market Prediction
